name: Genesis
summary: A lowlife who is on the run after having having created gambling debts cons a small town into thinking that he is their new pastor.

name: On the Third Day...
summary: Buddy returns home to attend his own funeral, but his new home is in an uproar after a couple of people are found dead and evidence sees Buddy as a suspect.

name: Bird of Pray
summary: After Buddy's first sermon, Schmidt calls in the bishop to assess his competence; Dora has an unusual request for Buddy; Alexa and Russell compete for Buddy's affection.

name: Thou Shalt Not Steal
summary: To pay off another gambling loss, Buddy steals a ruby necklace from a woman in a coffin. Dora and Alexa have a falling out over a church fashion show and Schmidt becomes smitten with a mystery woman.

name: Ex-Communication
summary: When Buddy tries to help Alexa escape her dark past, he puts both of their lives in danger. Dora has a meltdown when she learns her ex-fiance is getting married.

name: Honor Thy Boyfriend's Father and Mother
summary: Buddy surprises Russell's parents with a revelation about Russell, then gets a huge surprise of his own. Alexa instructs Dora in the art of self-pleasuring.

name: The Body of Kenny Compels You
summary: When Kenny's dead body is found, Buddy has to answer to Alexa, Schmidt and the police. A young blackmailer photographs the new pastor in a very compromising position.

name: Bingo Tell It on the Mountain
summary: Buddy is threatened by a new family in town; Dora asks Buddy for help to overcome a strange addiction; and Schmidt has a rendezvous with Ashlee.

name: Flings & Arrows
summary: An unexpected delivery threatens to expose Buddy as a fraud. Schmidt's wife accuses him of having an affair. A hired assassin comes to Ladner looking for Buddy.

name: Exodus
summary: Knowing there's a hit out on him, Buddy is forced to flee Ladner forever.

name: The Devil Went Down to Ladner
summary: Buddy's attempt to outfox the detectives backfires; Dora, Alexa and Russell suspect something ominous is going on with their new pastor; Schmidt learns the truth about Ashlee.

name: Guardian Angel
summary: The church must convince an eccentric elderly woman to donate her estate; Dora goes on a date with Detective Lovello; Schmidt makes a troubling confession.

name: Buddy's Prayer
summary: An ex-con threatens to burn down the church. Dora's relationship with Detective Lovello proves dangerous. Russell helps Schmidt set up his new bachelor pad.

name: Sins of the Past-or Part 1
summary: Buddy becomes trapped by a deadly criminal; the church council tries to stop an arson attempt on Ladner Trinity; and Dora meets up with her high school crush.

name: Sins of the Past-or Part 2
summary: Dora and Alexa come under threat and Buddy tries to decide who he can save. Also: Russell and Dora have a falling out and Schmidt falls victim to a robbery.

name: The Bish is Back
summary: Bishop Perkins returns with an announcement that rocks Trinity Lutheran. Sheriff Graham turns up the heat on Buddy regarding a recent murder in town. Alexa reveals an astonishing secret.

name: Ah-Men
summary: Russell calls on Buddy to become more of a leader in the gay community. Sheriff Graham enlists Dora to spy on Buddy and Alexa. Schmidt and Ashlee take their relationship public.

name: My Little Brother's Little Brother's Keeper
summary: Buddy's attempt to counsel Russell's little brother goes awry. Dora decides to run against Schmidt for church president. Buddy struggles with his feelings for Alexa.

name: Judge Not
summary: The FBI has a surprise plan for Buddy. Sheriff Graham finally drops the hammer on the pastor. Dora suspects Buddy has a female lover.

name: Thy Neighbor's Wife
summary: Buddy deals with the shocking arrival of Alexa's husband. Dora makes a frightening discovery. Schmidt's engagement party takes an unexpected turn.
